name: meta_query
description: Query metadata from z-meta (interface/dict/app/tenant/config). Returns a list of records matching the filter. Use this when the CEO agent needs to discover what APIs/services exist, look up a dictionary value, or audit a project's metadata. Supports 5+ metadata types via the `metaType` parameter. Backed by /api/interface/*, /api/dict/*, /api/meta-app/*, /api/meta-tenant/*, /api/private-config/*. Requires z-ctc 'meta:read' permission.

metaType.description: Which metadata type to query. 'interface' for API metadata, 'dict' for business dictionaries, 'app' for application registrations, 'tenant' for tenants, 'config' for private config.

appName.description: Optional: filter by application name. e.g. 'z-biz-news' to find all interfaces belonging to that app.

keyword.description: Optional: fuzzy search keyword. Searches path/name/description.
